name: Social Media
summary: Platform-agnostic social media entities - accounts, posts, hashtags, groups, and media - with a platform discriminator on every entity. Attribution to a person or organization stays in the Identity pack.
description:
Node types for what happens on a social platform: accounts, their public posts, the hashtags they use, the communities and channels they gather in, and the media attached to posts.

One set of types covers every platform. X/Twitter, Mastodon, Threads, Bluesky and others share the same types, and each type has a `platform` field to say which one a node belongs to. A separate pack per platform would leave no common type in which to ask whether an account on one platform and an account on another are the same person.

The pack is data only: it defines five node types in the `social` category and runs no code. It declares no edge types; relationships are recorded as edges in the project.

## Types

| Type | Label | Identified by | What it represents |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `social.account` | `username`, shown as `{username} · {platform}` | `platform`, `username` | An account on a social platform |
| `social.post` | `post_id`, shown as `{platform} · {post_id}` | `platform`, `post_id` | A public message on a social platform |
| `social.hashtag` | `hashtag`, shown as `{platform} · {hashtag}` | `platform`, `hashtag` | A hashtag or topic tag, a pivot for campaign and trend clustering |
| `social.group` | `name`, shown as `{name} · {platform}` | `platform`, `group_id` | A community or channel: an X Community, a Telegram channel, a Discord server, a Facebook group |
| `social.media` | `media_url` | `media_url` | An image, video, GIF or audio file attached to a post |

"Identified by" is the set of properties that decides whether two nodes are the same entity. `platform`, `username` and `hashtag` are matched without regard to case.

## Design

- **Attribution is not in this pack.** Which person or organisation is behind an account is an edge to `identity.person` or `identity.organization` in the Identity pack. This pack covers only what happens inside a platform.
- **`social.account` and `identity.account` are different nodes.** `identity.account` (Identity pack) is the thin node for "this handle exists on this site", used for cross-platform persona attribution. `social.account` is the platform-side profile, with followers, bio and post counts.
- **Media is identified by its URL alone**, without `platform`, so the same asset appearing in several posts is one node. That is what makes repost tracking possible.
- **`media_type` is a closed list**: `image`, `video`, `gif`, `audio`, `unknown`. A collector maps platform-specific values (X's `photo` or `animated_gif`, for example) onto it, and sends a value it does not recognise as `unknown`.

## Notable properties

- **Account.** `user_id` is the stable platform-scoped id, which does not change when the username does. Also `display_name`, `profile_url`, `avatar_url`, `bio`, `location` (as self-declared), `website`, `followers`, `following`, `post_count`, `verified` and `created_date`.
- **Post.** `url` (the permalink), `content`, `created_at`, `language`, `like_count`, `repost_count`, `reply_count`, `conversation_id` (the thread) and `media_urls`.
- **Hashtag.** Stored without the leading #, with `first_seen_at`.
- **Group.** `group_id` and `name` are both required; also `url`, `description`, `member_count` and `created_date`.
- **Media.** `platform` (optional here), `thumbnail_url`, `alt_text` as supplied by the author, `width` and `height`.

## Versions

The major version changes only when a type is removed or a type's identity changes. Adding properties is a minor release.

## Source

https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/typepack-social (file `typepacks/social.json`). Licence: Apache-2.0.

types.name: account
types.description: A social-media account (X/Twitter, Mastodon, Threads, Bluesky, ...). Attribution to a person or organization lives in the Identity typepack via `identity.controls`; this node is the platform-side identity only.

platform.description: Platform or service (e.g. x, mastodon, threads, bluesky).

username.description: Username or handle on the platform.

user_id.description: Stable platform-scoped account id (never changes when the username does).

display_name.description: Display name shown on the profile.

post_count.description: Number of posts by the account.

types.name: post
types.description: A public message on a social platform (X/Twitter, Mastodon, Threads, Bluesky, ...).

platform.description: Platform or service (e.g. x, mastodon, threads, bluesky).

content.description: Full text content of the post.

media_urls.description: Media URLs attached to the post (one per line or comma-separated).

types.name: hashtag
types.description: A hashtag / topic tag used in posts — a pivot for campaign and trend clustering.

first_seen_at.description: When the hashtag was first observed.

types.name: group
types.description: A social-media community or channel (X Community, Telegram channel, Discord server, Facebook group, ...).

types.name: media
types.description: Media attached to a post (image, video, GIF, audio). The media URL is the identity — the same asset is the same node even when it appears in different posts.

media_url.description: Direct URL of the media asset.

platform.description: Platform the media was observed on.

alt_text.description: Accessibility alt text supplied by the author.
